name: Frontend error correlation - exception.type inbox and toast trace lookup
purpose: Work the shared error inbox: every backend, worker and frontend exception is one record with exception.type set, so a single search covers the stack; a frontend toast's correlation id pasted into the trace view then shows the backend trace that produced the failed call.

hyperdx.select: timestamp, service.name, error_name, exception.type, exception.message, preview, correlation_id, route, deploy_id, release, trace_id

operator_notes: Narrow the inbox with AND service.name:frontend for browser reports, AND deploy_id:1a2b3c4 for a release, or AND task_name:sync_account_positions_task for worker records.
Triage order: deploy_id/release tags first, then task_name for Huey records, then route and error_name for frontend records.

A frontend toast shows a 32-hex id (showToastForApiError renders ApiError.requestId). Paste it into the trace view, or use the SQL fallback below - correlation_id is accepted only as a valid 32-hex trace id, anything else is dropped at intake (FrontendExceptionRequest._normalize_correlation_id).
clickhouse_sql:
SELECT
    Timestamp,
    ServiceName AS service_name,
    SpanAttributes['error_name'] AS error_name,
    SpanAttributes['exception.type'] AS exception_type,
    SpanAttributes['exception.message'] AS exception_message,
    SpanAttributes['preview'] AS preview,
    SpanAttributes['correlation_id'] AS correlation_id,
    SpanAttributes['route'] AS route,
    SpanAttributes['deploy_id'] AS deploy_id,
    SpanAttributes['release'] AS release,
    SpanAttributes['trace_id'] AS trace_id
FROM default.otel_traces
WHERE SpanAttributes['exception.type'] != ''
  AND Timestamp > now() - INTERVAL 1 DAY
ORDER BY Timestamp DESC
LIMIT 100
expected_result: Exception records newest first, service_name showing which process reported them; backend and worker records are the exception span itself, frontend records carry service_name 'frontend' with route/error_name/preview. For a toast id, the fallback lookup is: WHERE SpanAttributes['correlation_id'] = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef' OR SpanAttributes['trace_id'] = '0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef'.
sampling_and_retention: Exception records ride error spans (span status ERROR), so the tail-sampling policy retains them at 100 percent. These records are not catalog events: they carry exception.type and no event.name, so the row-level TTL falls through to the 30-day fallback tier (README section 5).
